[WebFetch 원문 인용 발췌 · 2026-10-07 조회 · 게시일 2026-06-08 (원문 표기 "June 8, 2026") · 저자 Ian Carlos Campbell]
"Google is lowering the cost of its cheapest AI subscription to make Gemini models even easier to access. The Google AI Plus plan will now cost $5 per month, according to a post from Vikas Kansal, the company's Product Lead focused on Gemini AI subscriptions, down from its original $8 per month price. It now also comes with double the storage, 400GB instead of 200GB. The subscription plan became available in January 2026 as a cheaper way to access Google's Gemini 3 Pro model, Nano Banana Pro and Deep Research."
